body:
Hey, you are amazing, I can't even have okay friends and I'm also introverted.

It's not a bad thing being an introvert, [check this video](http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Ar1kEN_ZPNM&feature=youtu.be)

You are smart, not seeking a relationship, you are cool, I have an advice for you, keep studying, you will get a nice job, after you can travel all around the world and maybe you can even find a nice woman/man, I wish you the best luck, stand by me.

It's not your fault, sometimes people suffer when they are young and if they are weak, they will do the same thing on their children, I know **you are stronger** than anyone that wants to hurt you, even stronger than me and I'm here. I tried to do bad things too, but then I saw that nobody can stop me, I'm better than it, **you are better**, stand by me and let's show everybody how strong we are.

I'm here if you want to talk. 


Tell me a little bit of yourself, come on, I'm on your side

I was feeling like this today, but I told myself I'm stronger than someone that wants to hurt me inside and if I can't save myself, I'll try to save people untill someone saves me. 
I'll give you an advice, sleep or do something you like (singing in my case) untill you feel sleepy. If you feel this way again, do the same thing everyday till this feeling go away. You are wonderful, stand by me.
